title: ¡Tito se disfraza de calabaza! 🎃🦷 | Canciones Infantiles #Shorts
world: cozy autumn night: porch with glowing smiling jack-o-lanterns, orange and purple fairy lights + warm bathroom-mirror corner
story: Tito pops out in a pumpkin costume put on backwards, only his trunk sticks out (funny problem)
Mamá laughs and turns the costume around; Tito shows a big grin (fix 1)
He grabs his candy bucket and runs to the door, but Mamá raises a toothbrush: first, teeth! (conflict)
Brushing in front of the mirror, bubbles, his teeth sparkle (the habit)
On the porch: glowing smiling jack-o-lanterns light up one by one (wonder)
A tiny friendly sheet ghost toy waves hello, Tito waves back and giggles (sweet, not scary)
Tito and Mamá share a candy under the orange lights (reward)
Tito tries to put the costume on his head again, backwards (loop gag)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Uy! ¿Dónde está Tito?
[Verse]
¡Calabaza al revés!
¿Dulces? ¡Primero, los dientes!
Cepillo, cepillo, ¡qué brillo!
[Chorus]
¡Calabazas que brillan!
¡Hola, fantasmita!
¡Dulce, dulce, qué rico!
[Outro]
¡Feliz noche, Tito!
style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: TITO, a baby elephant toddler. Powder-blue body, very big round ears with peach-pink insides, short soft trunk curled up at the tip, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white sparkle highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny tuft of three hairs on top of the head, wearing small sunny-yellow overalls with one round red button, short chubby arms and legs, small tail.
mama_lock: MAMÁ ELEFANTA, the mother of the baby elephant: a gentle grown-up adult elephant with motherly adult proportions, clearly taller and slimmer than a toddler, longer legs and a longer graceful trunk, soft lavender-grey body, big round ears with peach-pink insides, warm brown eyes with long eyelashes, a kind smile, wearing a soft lilac dress with tiny white polka dots, a white apron, and a small yellow flower behind one ear.

locations.porche: A cozy wooden house porch on an autumn evening, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: three big glowing orange jack-o-lanterns with friendly smiling carved faces on the steps, strings of warm orange and purple fairy lights, fallen orange and yellow leaves, a soft purple evening sky with a big friendly round moon, a small wooden front door with a wreath of autumn leaves. Nobody is on the porch.
locations.espejo: A warm cozy bathroom corner in the evening, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: a round mirror above a small white sink, a cup with a small blue toothbrush and a tube of toothpaste, a little wooden step stool, soft warm lamp light, purple and orange tiles, a tiny pumpkin decoration on the shelf. Nobody is in the bathroom.

shots: Extreme close-up: a round orange pumpkin costume worn backwards by the baby elephant, only the tip of his trunk peeking out of the costume's back opening, wiggling, a glowing jack-o-lantern blurred behind.
The pumpkin costume wobbles and the little trunk tip wiggles out of the opening.
Medium shot on the porch: Mamá Elefanta laughs kindly and turns the baby elephant's round orange pumpkin costume the right way; now his happy face shows through the face opening with a big grin.
Mamá gently turns the costume around and the baby elephant's face pops out grinning.

Medium shot on the porch: the baby elephant in the pumpkin costume holds a small orange candy bucket and runs toward the front door; Mamá Elefanta holds up a small blue toothbrush with a smile, like saying first teeth.
The baby elephant runs with the bucket, then stops and looks back at the toothbrush.
Close-up in front of the bathroom mirror: the baby elephant in his pumpkin costume brushes his teeth with a small blue toothbrush, white foam bubbles around his mouth, tiny sparkles on his teeth.
He brushes up and down, foam bubbles float up and his teeth sparkle.

Wide shot of the autumn porch at evening: three glowing jack-o-lanterns with friendly smiles light up, orange and purple fairy lights twinkle, the baby elephant in his pumpkin costume looks at them with wonder.
The jack-o-lanterns glow brighter one by one and the fairy lights twinkle.

Close-up on the porch: a tiny cute white sheet ghost toy with two big round friendly eyes and a little smile floats softly next to the baby elephant in his pumpkin costume; the baby elephant waves and giggles.
The tiny friendly ghost toy floats and waves; the baby elephant waves back and giggles.
Medium shot on the porch steps under orange fairy lights: the baby elephant in his pumpkin costume and Mamá Elefanta sit together and share a wrapped candy from the orange candy bucket, smiling.
They share the candy and smile at each other, the lights twinkle.
Medium shot on the porch: the baby elephant playfully pulls the round pumpkin costume over his head the wrong way again, only his trunk tip sticking out, wiggling.
The costume slips over his head backwards and his trunk tip wiggles out again.
